title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.37364v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.

translated_title: EmbeddingGemma 2：统一且高效的多模态表示
translated_abstract: 我们提出了EmbeddingGemma 2，一个开放的多模态嵌入模型，能够在统一空间中原生表示文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合。我们的方法引入了多项改进，例如简化的逐层嵌入以及带有模态和目标渐进的多阶段课程训练，确保模型在单模态、跨模态和混合模态评估中均具有出色的质量。值得注意的是，在涵盖所有模态的综合嵌入基准测试中，EmbeddingGemma 2建立了新的帕累托前沿，超越了各类专用模型以及规模比其大2到12倍的模型。此外，我们的设计为资源受限的环境提供了灵活性，支持选择性模态编码器加载、可调节的视觉token预算、可截断的嵌入维度以及量化权重。我们提供了分析关键设计决策的消融实验，并发布EmbeddingGemma 2以促进进一步研究。
tldr: EmbeddingGemma 2是一个开放的多模态嵌入模型，能在统一空间中原生表示文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合，在所有模态的嵌入基准中建立了新的帕累托前沿，以更小的规模超越了专用模型和比其大2到12倍的模型。
